title: Grew My Thinning Hair
text: This gel actually filled in my hair. My hair had thinned out on the top thanks to menopause and heredity. I absolutely saw results. It took about 6 months of use before I noticed my hair filled in. I used it two to three times a  week to slick down my bun. However, I can no longer use it. Sadly, my face does not like biotin. I didn’t make the connection that the gel was breaking my face out until very recently. I started battling adult acne around the time I started using it and attributed it to hormones. I tried prescription Retin-A, ProActivMd, Differin Gel and many other things over the past year and a half. Nothing cleared it up. Recently, I replaced it with Xtreme Wetline because I wanted more hold. After only a week of not using it, my face completely cleared.  If you’re looking for hair growth, this works! If you’re sensitive to biotin, be mindful of possible breakouts.

title: Best Hand Cream Ever - skin barrier-repair cream
text: I bought this from Rite Aid a few years back when I was spending the winter in Utah.  The weather there is very dry and my hands were dry and the finger tips were cracking and even bleeding.  While it didn't solve the bleeding finger tips (a derm doctor had a solution for that)  it did the absolute best job of keeping the natural moisture in my hands.  I use to use the Neutragena Fisherman's hand cream and swore by it until I found this cream.  It is cheaper and not as thick as the Fisherman's hand cream.  Glad Amazon is now carrying as it has been out of stock for nearly two years, at least in the smaller 1.7 oz size.  It functions like a barrier-repair cream allowing the skin to repair itself.  Takes a few minutes to absorb, but it is well worth it.  I limit it to the back of my hands as the gylcerin in the product can make your fingers a little slippery and like most cream can leave finger prints on glass, screen, etc.  The only other truly outstanding cream out there is Cerave which is also very moderately priced considering the expensive cermindes they put into it.  You can buy a big tub of the stuff for under $13.00.
